name: re8ch-tenant
description: Generic self-service access to RE8CH tenant capabilities through one identity-scoped control plane.

interface.shortDescription: Consume the capabilities granted to your tenant.
interface.longDescription: One tenant-neutral package for service lifecycle, registry, database, observability and BYOC capabilities. The OAuth identity selects the tenant and TenantGrant selects the permitted Consumables; prompts cannot choose either boundary.
defaultPrompt: Show the capabilities available to my tenant.
Plan this tenant service before creating it.
List my tenant resources and their usage.
